description.value:
Duration constant

A standing bonus against being forced to break your word.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would force you to break a promise, oath, or bargain against your will, and against compulsion effects generally.

cinderfall.incomplete: "+2 circumstance vs effects forcing a broken promise/oath/bargain, and vs compulsion effects generally" protects a homebrew narrative concept with no corresponding real pf2e trait -- there is no compulsion/oath-breaking trait in pf2e-source to predicate a bonus against.
